changed: The colour is drained from both figures, the older man is highlighted by an orange circle, and an arrow plus a dashed box labelled VICTIM appear and grow.
cause: Unclear; it looks like a deliberate highlight pointing at the older man and a label slot being introduced.

message: The narrator seems to be saying that the person in the highlighted role (the older man/manager) can end up being cast or seen as the victim.
